Nadia: Tiny life update 0 — I accepted a Director role this morning :tada: and also my partner and I are expecting our first baby (due Oct). Wanted to share because I:m pretty excited and also planning a small lunchtime celebration next Thursday.

Eli: Wow!! congrats on both, Nadia!! director life suits you :tada::raised_hands:

Sam: Incredible news :clap: will definitely be there. Also baby name brainstorming party? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Nadia: Haha maybe not a party; a short 20-min hang with cake would be perfect. Also if folks want to sign a card, drop a line here and I:ll print it.

Jo: Count me in. Cake preference poll: reply with emoji

:chocolate: chocolate
:lemon: lemon
:cake: vanilla

Ruth: :chocolate:

Eli: :lemon:

Sam: :cake:

Nadia: Looks like mixed flavors then. I:ll order an assortment. Thanks! Also logistics q: kitchen table or community room? I:d prefer community room for space.

Jo: Community room good. I can bring a small string of lights and napkins.

Ruth: I:ll grab a non-alcoholic sparkling cider.

Eli: I can do a quick slide with a celebratory GIF for a 1-min shoutout if you want.

Nadia: That:d be adorable, thanks. For the card, anyone who wants to leave 1-2 lines paste them here and I:ll compile:

Sam: "Nadia : You:re going to be an amazing director and parent. So proud of you!"

Jo: "Huge congrats! Can:t wait to celebrate next week. Sending all the good vibes."

Eli: "Congratulations on both huge milestones! Coffee on me when you:re ready to chat strategy or stroller options."

HR Bot: Event created: https://calendar.company.internal/e/1893056789-nadia-celebration (Thu Sep 14 12:00-12:30pm) :calendar: Please RSVP.

Nadia: Thank you everyone :heart: I:m feeling very lucky. Will send a short checklist for volunteers later this week.
